# Step - labels

`labels` · category: [Values and properties](../../traversal/step_reference.md#values-and-properties)

Yields the full label set of each vertex as a list (Graphersal multi-label vertices).

## Forms

```text
labels()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).labels().next()   // ["person"]
```

## See also

- [Multi-Label Vertices](../../users_guide/multi_label_vertices.md)
